verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents two native rule-driven automations. Threshold alerts fire notifications via Slack, GitHub Actions or webhooks when a metric crosses a threshold. Evaluator rules automatically score live production traces with LLM-as-a-Judge. Both are narrow, single-purpose mechanisms rather than a general event-to-action rule engine, and their configuration depth is only briefly mentioned. missing for 10: a general-purpose rule builder with configurable event types and arbitrary actions, detailed docs on rule conditions and filters, independent or hands-on corroboration that the alerts and automations work.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
